name: browser-use
headline: LLMs - Centralized LLM Configuration Management
short_description: Centralized LLM configuration and documentation management system. Enables operations teams to build and manage skills, commands, agents, and prompts. Supports multiple LLMs like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Integrates with MCP servers for deployment and management.
author: matteocervelli

sections.overview:
llms is a production-ready configuration system for Claude Code and Codex that includes 39 pre-built skills, unified hook dispatchers, and 21 safety rules. The system organizes workflows across SDLC pipeline, quality assurance, Git operations, documentation, and metadata management. It provides ready-to-use skills for discovery, implementation, code review, security audits, PR management, and deployment. Teams can clone the repository and integrate skills into their projects or install globally, with Codex-specific configuration available for alternative LLM environments.
Accelerate development workflows with pre-built SDLC pipeline skills
Enforce code quality and security standards across teams
Automate Git operations, PR creation, and release management
Implement safety hooks to block dangerous commands and protect sensitive files
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/matteocervelli/llms`
sections.usage:
```
Create a centralized LLM configuration for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The configuration should include skills, commands, agents, and prompts. Support multiple LLMs like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode. Ensure integration with MCP servers for deployment and management. Document all configurations and provide a user-friendly interface for operations teams.
```
Copy

```
# Centralized LLM Configuration for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] Sector

- **Data Analysis Prompt**: "Analyze the provided data set and generate insights."
- **Customer Support Prompt**: "Respond to the customer query with a detailed solution."
- **Code Generation Prompt**: "Generate optimized code for the given requirements."
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
